svg.title: Oil-consumption diagnostic path with no VIN
svg.desc: Operator symptom feeds GASLab gas analysis, which emits a chemical_state used to prune registry rules. Chemistry alone resolves rings, valve seals, and head gasket. POA_SIGNATURE is ambiguous and split into PCV versus turbo by the low-to-high idle gas signature. All converge to a confidence-scored verdict.
svg.text: Oil-consumption diagnosis — which of 5 failures is factual? (no VIN)
GASLab gas analysis — L1 (idle) + L2 (high idle)
Brettschneider λ = ground truth (ECU is only perception)
Split POA: λ at idle + CO
No VIN → horizon = LEGACY; forced-induction unconfirmed
Turbo (MW-009) vs PCV (MW-008) separate on the λ/CO gas signature ALONE —
the VIN forced-induction guard (U-OIL-FI-1) is unavailable, so a non-turbo engine
showing stoich-λ + extreme-HC could mis-trigger turbo — residual ambiguity to flag in the verdict.
